convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iAO - Awesome Oscillator). Simple crossover entry rules. Fixed lot sizing. No external .mqh dependencies. Standard market execution with SL/TP.

other_exits: Opposite AO signal closes current position before opening new one

custom_logic_notes: EA uses Awesome Oscillator (Bill Williams) zero-line crossover for signals. On opposite signal, existing position is closed before new position is opened. SL/TP values are input in points and need digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: Awesome Oscillator is available in most Python TA libraries (ta-lib, pandas-ta) as 'ao'. AO = SMA(median, 5) - SMA(median, 34). Entry on zero-line crossover confirmed on completed bar. SL/TP in points need to be converted to price distances, accounting for digit adjustment (5-digit vs 4-digit). Position check before entry: close existing position on opposite signal, then open new. New bar detection required — only evaluate signals once per completed bar.
